v1.title: First attempts
v1.note: Three different hands tried the same picture: one in the classic MS Paint way, one in oil, one in watercolour.

v2.title: Painting from a written plan
v2.note: The whole painting was planned on paper first, move by move, then painted from that plan.

v3.title: Learning to paint
v3.note: The first painting made stroke by stroke with an oil study as the guide.

v4.title: Agent K learns to paint
v4.note: Agent K paints the photo stroke by stroke in four styles. Big brushes first, fine marks last, always looking at the whole picture.

items.title: Classic MS Paint
items.note: Three artist agents, each in its own style, with a critique and revision loop. Polygon blocking, airbrush shading, pencil details.

items.title: Oil
items.note: Big brush masses and bristle strokes that follow the forms.

items.title: Watercolour
items.note: Transparent glazes built up in layers, spray for granulation.

items.title: Fable plan
items.note: Fable wrote the whole stroke plan before painting, a drawing agent executed it, judges scored it, five plan versions.

items.title: Painter, 1K oil target
items.note: A Python stroke placer driven by an art-direction file, with a Gemini oil rendering of the photo as the style target.

items.title: Oil
items.note: Pyramid stroke placer with whole-picture scoring, flat brush and palette knife, 2K oil target.

items.title: Watercolour
items.note: Same placer with soft glazes and spray, 2K watercolour target.

items.title: Coloured pencil
items.note: Bristle and pencil hatching, 2K coloured-pencil target.

items.title: Graphite sketch
items.note: Pencil only, black and white, 2K sketch target.
